blind.description: A small stylized standard rose bush or topiary tree. It features a short, narrow brown textured trunk supporting a dense, spherical crown made of green leaves interspersed with numerous stylized rose blossoms in shades of peach-pink and pale cream-yellow. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with well-defined petals and foliage.
blind.from_above: A rounded circular dome of dark green leaves densely studded with open coral-pink and cream-colored roses.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet in diameter across the canopy.
